info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Banking Accounts Limits-v3-spec
info.description: The List Banking Accounts Limits API provides financial institutions and their clients with the capability to retrieve the limits associated with various banking accounts. This endpoint enables users to access critical information regarding withdrawal limits, transaction limits, and other restrictions that may apply to their accounts. Typical consumers include banking applications and financial service providers seeking to enhance their user experience by providing account-specific limitations. By utilizing this API, developers can offer transparency and improve customer trust through clear visibility of account limits.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current limits associated with an account, providing valuable information on resource allocation and constraints.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving account limits, specifying details relevant to the request.

200.description: The request was successful and the account limits were retrieved.
